'''The Menagerie''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] state that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. It was led by the technology-hater [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Malakite]], a member of a powerful Sith dynasty known as the [[Calimondra family]]. During the [[Second Charge Matrica]], the Menagerie world of [[Skarpos]] was [[Capture of Skarpos|attacked and occupied]] by the rival Sith Lord [[Odion]], who ruled the [[Odionate]]. Lord Malakite then assembled a force to retake Skarpos. During the [[Massacre on Skarpos|Second Battle of Skarpos]], the armies of the Menagerie, the Odionate, and the [[Daimanate]] were destroyed by an ancient Sith weapon known as the [[Helm of Ieldis]], which was capable of driving sentient beings into a homicidal frenzy. Following the events on Skarpos, Lord Malakite's forces joined forces with the other Sith [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] in an attempt to defeat Lord Odion, who wanted to use the Helm to destroy [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Politics and society==
Like the other Sith fiefdoms that dominated the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]], the Menagerie was governed according to the personal beliefs and ideology of its ruling Sith Lord, in this case Lord [[Malakite]]. The technology-hating Lord Malakite gained a "perverted" reputation throughout Sith Space for using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] to transform sentient beings and animals into vicious red-skinned [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as "[[Mutate]]s" who were used to fill the ranks of his armed forces. These creatures were the leftovers of centuries of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] experimentation and had been reduced into vicious minions who only existed to served their Sith Lord's bidding.<ref name="SWKE11" /> Malakite's military forces included "Mutates", winged [[Menagerie dragon]]s, [[Night-Soarer]]s, and a fleet of military starships. Since the Sith Lord eschewed modern technology in favor of pre-modern weapons and claws, Malakite devised a tactic of using overwhelming numbers to swarm opponents with superior technology. Besides fighting the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Malakite also fought constant battles with other Sith [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] like [[Odion]] and [[Ayanos Bactra]]. Due to a high attrition rate, Lord Malakite was forced to implement a large-scale breeding program.<ref name="SWKE13">[[Knight Errant: Escape 3|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 3]]</ref>

==History==
The Menagerie was one of the break-away Sith states that was formed from the collapse of the [[Chagras Hegemony]] in [[1040 BBY]]. Under the reign of Lord Malakite, the Menagerie gained a reputation as a breeding ground for vicious Sithspawn and monsters. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the Menagerie joined forces with the [[Odionate]], the [[Daimanate]], and the Sith Lord [[Lioko]] in invading and dividing up the [[Bactranate]], a Sith fiefdom ruled by the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] Sith Lord Ayanos Bactra. Lord Malakite had responded to a request by the [[Calimondra family]]'s ruling matriarch, [[Vilia Calimondra]], who believed that Lord Bactra had outlived his usefulness to the Sith dynasty. Lord Malakite's territorial gains in the former Bactranate were formally recognized during a [[bequest]] convened by Vilia Calimondra.<ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] novel</ref>

In 1032 BBY, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Odion's forces [[Capture of Skarpos|invaded and expelled]] the Menagerie from [[Skarpos]], a barren desert world. Odion was looking for the [[Helm of Ieldis]], an ancient Sith artifact capable of driving sentient beings into a homicidal frenzy. Unknown to Odion, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] errant [[Kerra Holt]] had infiltrated the ranks of his forces.<ref name="SWKE11" /> Shortly later, Lord Malakite returned with an army to retake Skarpos. Malakite was followed by Odion's younger, the Sith Lord [[Daiman]], who wanted to take the Helm for himself.<ref name="SWKE13" /> During the ensuing [[Massacre on Skarpos|three-way battle]], Odion used the Helm to drive the three armies into a homicidal frenzy.<ref name="SWKE14">[[Knight Errant: Escape 4|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 4]]</ref> Following the events on Skarpos, the Menagerie, at the urging of Vilia Calimondra, joined forces with the other Sith fiefdoms to stop Lord Odion's attempt to use the Helm to destroy the entire galaxy. Ultimately, Lord Odion was defeated by the Jedi Kerra and his second-in-command [[Beld Yulan]].<ref name="SWKE15">[[Knight Errant: Escape 5|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 5]]</ref>
